LanguageData.GrechkaTraders_FrequencyHelp: Natural arrivals: ×1 = vanilla, ×0 = disabled, up to ×5. Existing traders and requested/quest caravans are unaffected. Results depend on the storyteller, factions and arrival conditions.
LanguageData.GrechkaTraders_CustomSlaves: Override slave numbers in slaver caravans
LanguageData.GrechkaTraders_SlaveHelp: Applies to newly generated caravans that already sell slaves. Does not add slaves to other traders or override faction ideology. Orbital and settlement stock stay unchanged.
LanguageData.GrechkaTraders_DiscountHelp: Default: 15%, adjustable from 0 to 30%. Applies when buying goods from the specialist’s mods, including packed buildings. Vanilla supporting supplies have regular prices.
